payout_quote: Get a $15 bonus and download the app over 50 million people trust with their money. ... When you create your account, remember to enter this referral code ... Send money within 14 days to unlock $15 for you and a referral bonus for Joey.
timing: $15 bonus unlocks after you send $5+ to another Cash App user within 14 days of creating the account; paid to your Cash App balance (cash out to bank via Cash App's standard Cash Out)
eligibility: New Cash App users only (US); enter a referral code when creating the account; send at least $5 to another Cash App user within 14 days
steps: Download Cash App and create a new account
Enter the referrer's referral code during account creation
Send at least $5 to another Cash App user within 14 days
$15 bonus is unlocked to your Cash App balance
catches: You must send $5 of YOUR OWN money to another person first - the $15 only unlocks after that send. Net new cash from the bonus is $10 after the $5 you sent, unless that $5 was paying someone you owed anyway (split a bill, pay a friend back).
The referral code must be entered at account creation; it cannot be added later.
The referrer-side bonus amount is not stated on the official page ('a referral bonus') - only the new-user $15 is officially documented, so this route is the new-user side only.
Bonus amounts can change by promotion; confirm the $15 in the app before funding.
biggest_catch: You must send $5 of your own money to someone else before the $15 unlocks - net new cash is $10 unless that $5 was a payment you owed anyway - and the referral code must be entered at signup, never after.

maximize: Make the $5 qualifying send do double duty: use it to pay someone you actually owe (split a bill, repay a friend), so the $5 isn't a sunk cost and the full $15 bonus is net-new money. The one unforgivable mistake is forgetting the referral code at signup: it can never be added later.
